summary: Phase 4 (Order Management & Fulfilment) fully verified. Full PHPUnit suite: 78/78 passing (268 assertions, 2.27s) — including new FulfilmentFlowTest (8) + ConversionServiceTest (6). Filament resource discovery confirmed (5 resources). Route table verified. E2E on preview URL: /admin/login=200, /order/{unknown 32-char}=404, /order/short=404, /order/{token} on in_progress purchase renders timeline (Payment received + Setting up your account) WITHOUT credentials, then flipping the same record to fulfilment_status=completed reveals provisioned username, password, expiry, setup instructions, and both download links with data-testid="dl-link". Confirmed at-rest encryption of provisioned_username_enc/provisioned_password_enc (raw DB cipher text differs from plaintext; accessor returns plaintext).

e2e_results.GET /order/{token} (in_progress): 200 — shows 'Order', 'IPTV 12 Months', '£60', 'Payment received', 'Setting up' timeline; NO provisioned/username/password/dl-link markers present.
e2e_results.GET /order/{token} (completed): 200 — reveals 'iptv_user_e2e', 'SecretPass!23', 'Completed', setup instructions ('Open the app...'), and two anchors with data-testid="dl-link" (iOS App + Android APK).
e2e_results.encryption_at_rest: Confirmed: raw provisioned_username_enc in DB begins 'eyJpdiI...' (base64 Laravel encrypted payload) != plaintext; Eloquent 'encrypted' cast returns 'iptv_user_e2e' via accessor.

critical_code_review_comments: Model note: provisioned_username_enc / provisioned_password_enc are used both as the DB column name and as the model attribute (encrypted cast). Naming is slightly confusing — the attribute reads as plaintext via the accessor while the '_enc' suffix implies ciphertext. Consider virtual accessors like $purchase->provisioned_username backed by the '_enc' column to make callsites cleaner (this is cosmetic; encryption behaviour is correct).

Purchase table has both legacy Phase-3 columns (preferred_username, delivery_method, amount_minor) and Phase-4 additions. Manual creation via tinker requires knowing this — feature tests use factory helpers which is fine. No action required.
download_links stored as JSON (array cast) rendered as <a data-testid="dl-link"> — verified in E2E.
test_credentials: preview-admin@example.com / AdminPass1234! (Filament login page renders 200; TOTP not driven). preview-verified@example.com / previewpass1234.
seed_data_creation: Created one E2E Purchase (id 01kzb3z5nr55gby8a5f7yc5sy8, token 'a'x32) linked to iptv-12-months, transitioned in_progress -> completed with provisioned creds + 2 download links, verified public page, then deleted at cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 is fully green. When recreating Purchase rows via tinker, use column names preferred_username, delivery_method, amount_minor (not buyer_username / delivery_channel / unit_price_pence). To reveal completed-state, assign to provisioned_username_enc / provisioned_password_enc directly (encrypted cast handles ciphering). Stripe remains unset — all webhook/event flows exercised offline via signed test payloads inside the feature suite.
